title: Frame normalization of the integration adjunct before section restriction
statement: For every finite commutative coefficient ring A annihilated by the positive integer N, every Noetherian base S with N invertible, every rank-d locally free module M on S, every Noetherian open W and every linear frame e on W, the inverse-image of the actual integration adjunct along the inverse frame, followed by the canonical exceptional base-change map, equals the canonical affine coefficient comparison followed by the ordered coordinate-tower counit adjunct. This statement is on the total affine bundle chart, before restriction to any section; no chosen orientation or new normalization hypothesis is an input. The definitions and canonical comparisons are those of [def-amb-vector-integration], [def-trf-coordinate-counit-arrows], [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], [thm-amb-vector-bundle-purity]. The chart coefficient comparison is written with the projection compositor whose common composite is the bundle-chart projection, indexed by the given Cartesian-square equality; compositor coherence identifies this with the equality-transport presentation of vectorIntegrationChartCoefficient.

source.place: Step 4, frame integration transpose and restriction along the zero section; parent proof Step 7.

proof.text: The defining VectorIntegrationNormalization equation holds on W, including non-affine W. Inverse compact-support exchange exists by open base change. Cancel exchange in that equation. The naturality identity for adjunction Hom equivalences transposes it; by definition the transpose of inverse compact-support exchange is the exceptional base-change map. Naturality in the coefficient object composes with constant-unit pullback on the other side of the Hom equivalence. The source-library singleFunctorObjUnitIso inverse is identity, and its pullback-unit square identifies constant-complex unit pullback with monoidal unit pullback. After these identity factors cancel, the affine transpose is exactly CoordinateCounitArrows.towerAdjoint. Rank zero, empty opens, and the zero ring use the identical unit equations. Finally compositor coherence expresses the chart coefficient isomorphism with the common composite indexed by the given projection square, giving the displayed equation.

theorem vectorIntegration_frameAdjoint (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A] (hA : (N : A) = 0)
    (t : OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport A N hA)
    (D : ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian T] (hT : IsUnit (N : Γ(T, ⊤))),
      OrdinaryFiniteP1Datum A N hA t T hT)
    (S : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian S] (hS : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤))) (d : ℕ)
    (M : SheafOfModules.{u} S.ringCatSheaf) [M.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank d] (W : S.Opens)
    [IsNoetherian W.toScheme] (e : VectorBundleZeroSection.Trivialization S d M W) :
    letI : IsAffineHom (VectorBundleZeroSection.π S d M) :=
      (vectorIntegration_geometry S d M).1
    letI : LocallyOfFiniteType (VectorBundleZeroSection.π S d M) :=
      (vectorIntegration_geometry S d M).2.1
    (ordinaryFinitePullback A (vectorIntegrationChart S d M W e)).map
        ((vectorBundlePurityAdjunction A S d M).homEquiv _ _
          (vectorBundleIntegration N hN A hA S hS d M)) ≫
      dualizingComplexBaseChangeMap A (vectorIntegrationChart_isPullback S d M W e) =
    (leftDerivedUpperStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)
      (vectorIntegrationChart S d M W e) (VectorBundleZeroSection.π S d M)).inv.app
        (affineLinearBaseCoefficient A N hA S d) ≫
      (leftDerivedUpperStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (affineTraceProjection W.toScheme d)
        W.ι (vectorIntegrationChart S d M W e ≫ VectorBundleZeroSection.π S d M)
        (vectorIntegrationChart_isPullback S d M W e).w).hom.app
          (affineLinearBaseCoefficient A N hA S d) ≫
      (ordinaryFinitePullback A (affineTraceProjection W.toScheme d)).map
        (vectorIntegrationBaseCoefficientPullback A N hA t W.ι hS d).hom ≫
      (affineLinearCoefficientDescent A N hA t W.toScheme
        (affineTracePullbackInvertible N W.ι hS) d).inv ≫
      CoordinateCounitArrows.towerAdjoint N hN A hA t D W.toScheme
        (affineTracePullbackInvertible N W.ι hS) d
